title: Joy 2 Unit 1 課後複習
topic: 描述昆蟲顏色 / It is a...

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.text: It's red, orange, yellow, green, blue, black, and white.
dialogueLines.zh: 牠身上有紅色、橘色、黃色、綠色、藍色、黑色和白色。

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.zh: 嘿，蟲蟲，你的名字叫什麼？

dialogueLines.speaker: Fifi
dialogueLines.text: Hey pretty bug, what's your name?
dialogueLines.zh: 嘿，漂亮的蟲蟲，你的名字叫什麼呀？

grammar.rule: 一個東西用 It is a...；開頭是 a、e、i、o、u 母音的字要用 an（an ant、an apple）。

title: Joy 2 Unit 2 課後複習
topic: Is it...? / I don't know.

grammar.rule: 問「是…嗎？」用 Is it a...?；是就答 Yes, it is.，不是就答 No, it is not.

quiz.full: Is it a house? Yes, it is.

quiz.prompt: Is it a window?（不是窗戶）
quiz.full: Is it a window? No, it is not.
Is it a door? Yes, it is.

quiz.prompt: Is it a house?（不是房子）
quiz.full: Is it a house? No, it is not.

title: Joy 2 Unit 3 課後複習
topic: 形狀與顏色 / It is a blue star.

dialogueLines.speaker: Fifi
dialogueLines.zh: 是派對耶！看起來好好吃喔！

dialogueLines.speaker: Abby
dialogueLines.text: Look at this window. It's a star.
dialogueLines.zh: 看看這扇窗戶。它是星星形狀的。

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.zh: 它是黃色的星星。看起來好好吃！

dialogueLines.speaker: Abby
dialogueLines.text: Look at that door. It's a heart.
dialogueLines.zh: 看看那扇門。它是愛心形狀的。

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.zh: 它是紅色的愛心。看起來好好吃！

grammar.rule: 顏色放在形狀前面：It is a + 顏色 + 形狀.（It is a blue star.）

quiz.prompt: It is a ___ star.（藍色的星星）
It is a ___ heart.（黃色的愛心）
It is a ___ heart.（紅色的愛心）
It is a ___ star.（黃色的星星）

talkPairs.q: Look at this window. It's a star.
Look at that door. It's a heart.

title: Joy 2 Unit 4 課後複習
topic: 感覺 / Are you...? / Me too.

grammar.rule: 問別人的感覺用 Are you...?；是就答 Yes, I am.，不是就答 No, I am not.

quiz.full: Are you hungry? Yes, I am.
quiz.zh: 你肚子餓了嗎？——對，我餓了。

quiz.full: Are you happy? No, I am not.
Are you sad? Yes, I am.
Are you OK? No, I am not.

title: Joy 2 Unit 5 課後複習
topic: 萬聖節 / Sight Words: yes, no, not / Be tidy.

grammar.rule: 常見字 yes、no、not：是就說 Yes，不是就說 No，「不是」用 not。句子開頭的字母要大寫。

quiz.prompt: Is it a house?　___, it is.（是）
quiz.full: Is it a house? Yes, it is.

quiz.prompt: Is it a door?　___, it is not.（不是）
quiz.full: Is it a door? No, it is not.

quiz.prompt: Are you sad?　___, I am not.（不難過）
quiz.full: Are you sad? No, I am not.

quiz.prompt: Are you hungry?　___, I am.（餓了）
quiz.full: Are you hungry? Yes, I am.

title: Joy 2 Unit 6 課後複習
topic: Is this...? / 近處家具文具 / Thank you.

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: It's OK. Come in! What's your name?
dialogueLines.zh: 沒關係。請進！你的名字叫什麼？

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.text: My name is Nick. This is Abby.
dialogueLines.zh: 我的名字叫做尼克。這位是艾比。

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Oh, hi, Nick. Hi, Abby. How are you?
dialogueLines.zh: 喔，嗨，尼克。嗨，艾比。你們好嗎？

dialogueLines.speaker: Abby
dialogueLines.text: I'm great. Thank you. And you?

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Yes, it is. It's a smart chair.
dialogueLines.zh: 是，它是。它是一張聰明的椅子。

grammar.rule: 問近處的東西用 Is this a...?（這是…嗎？）

talkPairs.a: Yes, it is. It's a smart chair.

title: Joy 2 Unit 7 課後複習
topic: Is that...? / 遠處家具文具

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Yes, it is. It's a happy TV.
dialogueLines.zh: 是，它是。它是一台開心的電視機。

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Yes, it is. It's a shy clock.
dialogueLines.zh: 是，它是。它是個害羞的時鐘。

grammar.rule: 近的用 this（這個），遠的用 that（那個）。

talkPairs.a: Yes, it is. It's a happy TV.
Yes, it is. It's a shy clock.

phonicsNote: Ll 有字首（leg）和字尾（bell）兩種讀音

title: Joy 2 Unit 8 課後複習
topic: What is this? / 動物與顏色

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: And this is my dog, Toto.
dialogueLines.zh: 還有這隻是我的狗，托托。

grammar.rule: 問「這是什麼？」用 What is this?，回答 It is...

phonicsNote: Mm 有字首（man）和字尾（gum）兩種讀音

title: Joy 2 Unit 9 課後複習
topic: What time is it? / 數字 1–4

grammar.rule: 問時間用 What time is it?，回答 It is ... o'clock.

phonicsNote: Nn 有字首（nut）和字尾（bin）兩種讀音

title: Joy 2 Unit 10 課後複習
topic: 複習 U1–U4、U6–U9 / Sight Words: this, that, time / Pay attention.

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Yes, it is. It's a smart chair.
dialogueLines.zh: 是，它是。它是一張聰明的椅子。

dialogueLines.speaker: Old Lady
dialogueLines.text: Yes, it is. It's a shy clock.
dialogueLines.zh: 是，它是。它是個害羞的時鐘。

grammar.rule: 常見字 this（這個，近的）、that（那個，遠的）、time（時間）。

talkPairs.a: Yes, it is. It's a smart chair.

title: Joy 2 Unit 11 課後複習
topic: Who is he/she? / 爸爸媽媽

dialogueLines.speaker: Abby
dialogueLines.text: Good evening. I'm Abby. This is Nick.
dialogueLines.zh: 晚安。我是艾比。這位是尼克。

dialogueLines.speaker: Bobo
dialogueLines.text: I'm fine. Thank you. And you?

grammar.rule: 問「他/她是誰？」用 Who is he/she?；男生用 he，女生用 she。

title: Joy 2 Unit 12 課後複習
topic: What is that? / 玩具 / Time to go home.

dialogueLines.speaker: Bobo's mom
dialogueLines.text: It's six o'clock. Time to go home.

grammar.rule: 問遠處的東西用 What is that?，回答 It is a...

talkPairs.a: It's six o'clock. Time to go home.

phonicsNote: Rr 有字首和字尾兩種讀音

title: Joy 2 Unit 13 課後複習
topic: 哥哥姊姊弟弟妹妹 / He/She is my...

grammar.rule: 哥哥＝big brother、弟弟＝little brother、姊姊＝big sister、妹妹＝little sister。

title: Joy 2 Unit 14 課後複習
topic: How old are you? / 數字 5–8 / 大小

dialogueLines.speaker: Nick
dialogueLines.text: Me too! I'm seven years old.

grammar.rule: 問年紀用 How old are you?，回答 I am ... years old.

title: Joy 2 Unit 15 課後複習
topic: 母親節 / Sight Words: who, how, old / Be careful.

grammar.rule: 常見字 who（誰）、how（怎麼樣）、old（…歲）。How old are you? 就是「你幾歲？」

title: Joy 2 Unit 16 課後複習
topic: Where is my...? / 冷熱 / 食物

dialogueLines.speaker: Bobo
dialogueLines.text: I'm hungry. Where's my soup, Mom?
dialogueLines.zh: 我肚子餓了。媽媽，我的湯在哪裡？

grammar.rule: 問東西在哪裡用 Where is my...?；在這裡說 Here.，在那裡說 There.

quiz.zh: 我的香蕉在哪裡？——在這裡。

title: Joy 2 Unit 17 課後複習
topic: my brother's... / 大小冷熱 / It is...

dialogueLines.speaker: Bobo
dialogueLines.text: Thank you. This is my brother's chair.
dialogueLines.zh: 謝謝妳。這是我哥哥的椅子。

grammar.rule: 描述東西用 It is + 形容詞：big 大、small 小、hot 熱、cold 冷。

title: Joy 2 Unit 18 課後複習
topic: Is it tall? / 高矮胖瘦

grammar.rule: 問外表用 Is he/she/it + tall/short/fat/thin?

quiz.prompt: No, she is not. She is ___.（她瘦瘦的）
quiz.full: No, she is not. She is thin.

title: Joy 2 Unit 19 課後複習
topic: Is it in/on/under...? / HELP!!

dialogueLines.speaker: Bobo
dialogueLines.text: Look! It's not a monster. It's a girl. And she's on my bed.
dialogueLines.zh: 看啊！牠不是怪獸。是一個女生。而且她還睡在我的床上。

grammar.rule: 位置：in 在…裡面、on 在…上面、under 在…下面。

quiz.prompt: Is it ___ the box?（在箱子裡面）
Is it ___ the desk?（在書桌下面）
Is it ___ the TV?（在電視上面）
Is it ___ the chair?（在椅子下面）

title: Joy 2 Unit 20 課後複習
topic: 複習 U11–U14、U16–U19 / Sight Words: where, here, there / Be polite.

grammar.rule: 常見字 where（哪裡）、here（這裡）、there（那裡）。

quiz.prompt: ___ is my soup?（我的湯在哪裡？）

quiz.zh: 我的蘋果在哪裡？——在這裡。
我的牛奶在哪裡？——在那裡。

phonicsNote: 複習 Aa–Zz（挑 13 個字母）
